Build's clean now (exit 0). Two real bugs from the bump, both fixed:

- `src/core/options.js:6` — `resolveRetries` still read `options.retries`, but the bumped bundler now hands options as `{ retryCount }`, so it crashed on `undefined.toFixed()`. Now reads `options.retryCount`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js:7` — `isBackoffEnabled` threw on `undefined`, but the bumped config loader now leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`. Now treats `undefined` the same as `false` (disabled).

The remaining ~8 warnings (Node deprecations like `fs.exists`/`Buffer()`, plus the unused-export/circular-import notices) are pre-existing noise, not build-breaking — worth cleaning up eventually but not blockers.
